references.text: Also deals with punishing those who lead others into idolatry in the cities the Lord gives, and describes evil done to the Lord by breaking the covenant
Describes breaking the covenant with the Lord by serving other gods, using the same expression 'to break his covenant'
Achan's sin is an example of doing what is evil in the Lord's sight and breaking the covenant, which led to judgment over all Israel
Warning against breaking the covenant with the Lord that was given to them
Israel broke God's covenant by serving other gods, the same theme of covenant-breaking
The kings of Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight and broke the covenant
Prophetic description of those who break the eternal covenant
Warning against forgetting the Lord's covenant and making carved images, which is evil in the Lord's sight
